# Trex Australia

> > Trex Australia: Composite decking, aluminum railing systems, and outdoor living solutions made from recycled materials.

Trex is the world's leading manufacturer of eco-friendly composite decking and railing systems. The site features product lines including Trex Transcend, Trex Signature Railing, Trex Pergola, and Trex Outdoor Lighting, along with comprehensive deck building guides through Trex Academy and design inspiration from HGTV partnerships.

## Key Topics

- Composite Decking
- Trex Transcend
- Trex Signature Railing
- Trex Academy
- Deck Building & Installation
- Outdoor Living Design
- Sustainability & Recycled Materials
- Trex Pergola
- Trex Outdoor Lighting
- HGTV Smart Home Projects
- Carmen Johnston (Designer)
- Picture Framing & Multi-Level Decks
- Trex Fascia & Hideaway Fasteners
- Deck Planning & Material Estimation
- Eco-Friendly Building Solutions

## Deck Building Guides & Installation

- [Deck Building Guides](https://au.trex.com/academy/how-to-guides): Trex Academy deck building guides, videos, and installation tutorials
- [How to Build and Frame a Multi-Level Deck](https://au.trex.com/academy/how-to-guides/all-guides/how-to-build-and-frame-a-multi-level-deck): Multi-level deck building and framing instructions with transition steps
- [How to Picture Frame a Deck Like a Pro](https://au.trex.com/academy/how-to-guides/all-guides/picture-framing-deck): Picture framing deck border installation guide with blocking details
- [How to Fasten Trex® Fascia with Trex Hideaway® Color Match Composite Fascia Screws](https://au.trex.com/academy/how-to-guides/all-guides/how-to-fasten-trex-fascia-with-trex-hideaway-color-match-compo): Installation guide for Trex Hideaway Color Match Composite Fascia Screws
- [How Many Deck Boards Do I Need?](https://au.trex.com/deck-ideas/how-many-deck-boards-do-i-need-): Deck board calculation guide for material estimation and planning
